
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/keepee/p/19442704" title="发布于 2026-01-05 14:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">UOS环境C#/Avalonia将文件剪切到剪切（粘贴）板实现</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>问题描述：</p>
<p>Avalonia的剪切板IClipboard实现目前（Ver11.3.10）在UOS国产系统下不能成功将文件写入剪切板，在桌面文件夹粘贴时会报错：</p>
<p><img alt="截图_dde-desktop_20251222104534" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/723147/202601/723147-20260105135929792-1476113706.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>尝试了Avalonia的DataObject旧方法和直接用C#操纵X11，也试了xclip-copyfile命令行，均未能成功，最后曲线救国，采用自编译可执行文件，在软件里调用成功，实现在软件内选择文件复制，然后在桌面文件夹粘贴OK。</p>
<p>以下是需要的代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_a3320feb-5a21-41fa-9421-ddf405b8ad71" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_a3320feb-5a21-41fa-9421-ddf405b8ad71" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_a3320feb-5a21-41fa-9421-ddf405b8ad71" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">一、实现思路
使用X11库与系统剪切板交互
将文件路径转换为URI格式
设置剪切板数据为x</span>-special/gnome-copied-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">files格式

二、完整代码
#include </span>&lt;stdio.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;stdlib.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;X11/Xlib.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;X11/Xatom.h&gt;

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将文件路径转换为文件URI</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>* file_to_uri(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filepath) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 简单的实现，实际应该进行URL编码</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> length = strlen(filepath) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> "file:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">" + 原路径 + '\0'</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>* uri =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> malloc(length);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (uri == NULL) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NULL;
    
    snprintf(uri, length, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file://%s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, filepath);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uri;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置文件到剪切板</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> set_file_to_clipboard(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filepath) {
    Display</span>* display =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> XOpenDisplay(NULL);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">display) {
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法打开X显示\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    Window window </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> XCreateSimpleWindow(display, 
                                       DefaultRootWindow(display),
                                       </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取剪切板原子</span>
    Atom clipboard = XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CLIPBOARD</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    Atom targets_atom </span>= XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TARGETS</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    Atom text_atom </span>= XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TEXT</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    Atom utf8_atom </span>= XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UTF8_STRING</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    Atom x_special_atom </span>= XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x-special/gnome-copied-files</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    Atom uri_list_atom </span>= XInternAtom(display, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text/uri-list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, False);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转换为URI格式</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>* uri =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> file_to_uri(filepath);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uri) {
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法创建URI\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        XCloseDisplay(display);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建剪切板数据
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> GNOME格式: copy\nfile:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">path</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> copy_cmd_len = strlen(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">copy\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) + strlen(uri) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>* copy_cmd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> malloc(copy_cmd_len);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">copy_cmd) {
        free(uri);
        XCloseDisplay(display);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    snprintf(copy_cmd, copy_cmd_len, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">copy\n%s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, uri);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> URI列表格式: file:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">path</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>* uri_list = malloc(strlen(uri) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> uri + \n + \0</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uri_list) {
        free(uri);
        free(copy_cmd);
        XCloseDisplay(display);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    snprintf(uri_list, strlen(uri) </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%s\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, uri);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置剪切板所有权</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    XSetSelectionOwner(display, clipboard, window, CurrentTime);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (XGetSelectionOwner(display, clipboard) !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> window) {
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法获取剪切板所有权\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        free(uri);
        free(copy_cmd);
        free(uri_list);
        XCloseDisplay(display);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待剪切板请求</span>
    XEvent <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        XNextEvent(display, </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span>.type ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SelectionRequest) {
            XSelectionRequestEvent</span>* req = &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.xselectionrequest;
            XSelectionEvent notify </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
            
            notify.type </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SelectionNotify;
            notify.display </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">display;
            notify.requestor </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">requestor;
            notify.selection </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">selection;
            notify.target </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">target;
            notify.property </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property;
            notify.time </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time;
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (req-&gt;target ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x_special_atom) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置x-special/gnome-copied-files格式</span>
                XChangeProperty(req-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property,
                              utf8_atom, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, PropModeReplace,
                              (unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)copy_cmd, strlen(copy_cmd));
                notify.property </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property;
                XSendEvent(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, False, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (XEvent*)&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (req-&gt;target ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uri_list_atom) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置text/uri-list格式</span>
                XChangeProperty(req-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property,
                              utf8_atom, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, PropModeReplace,
                              (unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)uri_list, strlen(uri_list));
                notify.property </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property;
                XSendEvent(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, False, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (XEvent*)&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (req-&gt;target ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targets_atom) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回支持的格式</span>
                Atom targets[] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { x_special_atom, uri_list_atom, text_atom, utf8_atom };
                XChangeProperty(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property,
                              XA_ATOM, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, PropModeReplace,
                              (unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*)targets, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(targets)/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(targets[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]));
                notify.property </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property;
                XSendEvent(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, False, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (XEvent*)&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (req-&gt;target == text_atom || req-&gt;target ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> utf8_atom) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 纯文本格式（文件路径）</span>
                XChangeProperty(req-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property,
                              utf8_atom, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, PropModeReplace,
                              (unsigned </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)filepath, strlen(filepath));
                notify.property </span>= req-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">property;
                XSendEvent(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, False, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (XEvent*)&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 不支持的目标</span>
                notify.property =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None;
                XSendEvent(req</span>-&gt;display, req-&gt;requestor, False, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (XEvent*)&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">notify);
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span>.type ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SelectionClear) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    free(uri);
    free(copy_cmd);
    free(uri_list);
    XDestroyWindow(display, window);
    XCloseDisplay(display);
    
    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件 '%s' 已复制到剪切板\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, filepath);
    printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">现在可以在文件管理器中右键粘贴或使用Ctrl+V粘贴\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> argc, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> argv[]) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (argc != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用法: %s &lt;文件路径&gt;\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">示例: %s /home/user/example.txt\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查文件是否存在</span>
    FILE* file = fopen(argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>], <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">file) {
        fprintf(stderr, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误: 文件 '%s' 不存在或无法读取\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    fclose(file);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> set_file_to_clipboard(argv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
}

三、编译方法
# 安装必要的开发库
sudo apt</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> install libx11-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dev
# 编译程序
gcc </span>-o <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-file-clipboard <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-file-clipboard.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">lX11

四、使用方法

# 设置文件到剪切板
.</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>-file-clipboard /path/to/your/file.txt</pre>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> UOS(dde-file-manager)剪切文件

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task SetFilesToClipboard(List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filePaths)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (filePaths == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || filePaths.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每个带空格的文件路径都需要用引号包围</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> arguments = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, filePaths.Select(fp =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\"{fp.Replace(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>\<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\\\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)}\<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ));

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> exePath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">set-files-to-clipboard</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">File.Exists(exePath))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> FileNotFoundException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">可执行文件不存在: {exePath}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> File.GetUnixFileMode(exePath);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> ((mode &amp; UnixFileMode.UserExecute) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                File.SetUnixFileMode(exePath, 
                    mode </span>| UnixFileMode.UserExecute |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
                    UnixFileMode.GroupExecute </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
                    UnixFileMode.OtherExecute);
                LogHelper.Info($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已为 {exePath} 设置执行权限</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            LogHelper.Error($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">设置权限失败: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> process = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Process
    {
        StartInfo </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> exePath,
            Arguments </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arguments,
            UseShellExecute </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            RedirectStandardOutput </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

        }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> output = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.WaitForExitAsync();

    }
    
    LogHelper.Info(output);
}
